text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Vietnamese press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-- Hanoi is seeking French help to improve its environment through a bilateral cooperation programme.
-- Ho Chi Minh City expects to register export turnover of $4.84 billion this year, an increase of 30 percent over last year's level.
-- Candidates in this year's National Assembly elections are permitted to use the mass media for their election campaigns.
-- 15 out of the twenty defendants in the recent Tamexco corruption trial have lodged appeals against the court's verdict.
-- General Secretary Do Muoi has urged scientists among overseas Vietnamese communities to make greater contributions towards building the country.
-- Argentina's President Carlos Menem has arrived in Hanoi for an official visit to strengthen cooperation between the two countries.
-- A failure to set targets for imports and exports caused disadvantages for the economy in 1996 and was a reason for the year-end trade deficit of $4.0 billion.
-- Foreign Minister Nguyen Manh Cam began a three-day official visit to Australia on Sunday to promote trade ties between the two countries.
